project_type: TypeScript ESM monorepo: deterministic, browser-rendered blocky-style vertical comedy video factory (Node runs .ts natively). The relevant subsystem is the S7 full-video render pipeline plus the S6 'vignette' staging/scene/camera pipeline.
language: TypeScript (native .ts execution under Node >= 22.18, no build step for node scripts; a tsc web bundle is built to dist/ for the browser page modules).
build_system: npm. tsc 7.0.2 (devDependency) builds tsconfig.web.json to dist/ for browser page modules. Node executes .ts directly for tools/scripts. Rendering needs playwright-core (devDependency) + a Chromium build (npx playwright install chromium or CHROMIUM_PATH). MP3 decode + ffprobe need ffmpeg binaries that are NOT on PATH in this sandbox.
test_framework: node --test with tests/*.test.ts. Fixtures/helpers in tests/helpers.ts. Some tests are pure/in-memory; render integration tests need Chromium.
build_command: npm run typecheck  (tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit).  Browser bundle: npm run build (tsc -p tsconfig.web.json) — render-full.ts also runs tsc itself before launching the page.
test_command: node --test tests/security.test.ts ; node --test tests/vignette-runtime-integration.test.ts ; node packages/captions/tools/verify-mvp.ts ; node scripts/narrated-integration-analysis.ts
verification_instructions: 1) npm run typecheck. 2) node --test tests/security.test.ts. 3) node --test tests/vignette-runtime-integration.test.ts. 4) node packages/captions/tools/verify-mvp.ts (this reads packages/captions/full-render/verification.json and asserts the v1 mp4 SHA-256/bytes are UNCHANGED — so v1 output must never be touched). 5) node scripts/narrated-integration-analysis.ts (47/47 gates, exit 0). 6) The v2 render tool itself (extended render-full.ts in vignette mode) runs runVignette + dense 30fps camera audit + teacher/door pixel gates + performance-motion gates + caption face-safety + production profile + Chromium seek/playback + AAC round-trip + MP4 audio alignment, and writes verification.json; all must pass. Chromium is required for the render + playback verification.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/captions/full-render/ (v1: zapp-vs-kira-full-s7.mp4 sha256 6317404e146e8b7fd9bef5e56760bdfa0f99c51e9de8da61ffb6ead1fa6afe28, verification.json, frame-*.png) is checked in and its hashes are asserted by verify-mvp.ts — treat as immutable golden. v2 goes in a NEW dir packages/captions/full-render-v2/. Regenerate the render by running the extended render-full.ts vignette mode with --voice pointing at the verified MP3 and --ffmpeg pointing at the installed binary.
setup_instructions: npm install (installs typescript + playwright-core). npx playwright install chromium (or set CHROMIUM_PATH). ffmpeg/ffprobe are NOT on PATH: install them from npm (ffmpeg-static@5.3.0 provides an ffmpeg binary; ffprobe-static@3.1.0 provides ffprobe) as devDependencies, then pass --ffmpeg <ffmpeg-static path> to render-full.ts and export FFPROBE_PATH=<ffprobe-static path> so probe-node.ts uses real ffprobe. Network is OPEN_INTERNET so npm registry, Chromium download, and Google Drive are reachable. gdown is NOT installed; download Drive files with the confirm-token two-step via curl, or pip install gdown.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET (npm registry reachable, curl to Google works, Chromium install works). ffmpeg/ffprobe absent from PATH — MUST be installed (ffmpeg-static + ffprobe-static from npm). gdown absent (use curl confirm-token or pip install gdown). node v22.23.3. python3 available (3.9 default via pyenv shims; scripts/review-requirements.txt exists for any python analysis). Downloaded media (voice MP3, competitor MP4s) and analysis artifacts MUST stay under .scratch/ (already gitignored) and MUST NOT be committed.
contribution_requirements: .gitignore covers node_modules/, dist/, out/, .scratch/, *.log. Keep competitor MP4s and raw voice MP3 in .scratch/. Stage files by explicit name (never git add -A/.). Work commits to branch feature/competitor-performance-v2. Do NOT push or open PR (orchestrator does that into integration/vignette-v1). Never modify git config, never force-push. The approved VO bytes/timing must never be altered. Do not weaken camera-safety or caption-safety gates.
key_patterns: render-full.ts is the proven H.264/AAC/mux/probe/playback tool: it authenticates the approved MP3 (checkContainer + SHA-256 == storyboard.audio.contentHash), decodes to 48kHz mono via ffmpeg, pads voice to N frames (never cuts), builds captions (planBoldCaptions/checkBoldPlan), text graphics, VFX events, and the audio mix (mixVoiceSfx, targetLufs -14, truePeak -1, music forced none, beat-sheet music entries ignored), then builds the tsc web bundle, launches Chromium, loads a page module that exposes window.__s7 { ready, init, place, initCapture, encodeRange, meta }, checks caption face conflicts, encodes N frames via WebCodecs, muxes fast-start MP4 (muxMp4), probes (checkProductionProfile), and verifies independent playback (verifyPlayback), AAC round-trip (aacRoundTrip SNR>=15dB), and container audio alignment (mp4AudioAlignment lag<=48 samples, decoded within 1024 samples). The CURRENT visual source is stills-page.ts which uses NarratedScene/buildWorldPlan (legacy, ignores teacher/door/actions). The NEW visual source is the vignette pipeline: runVignette(sheet, lib, {phrases}) -> {validation, stage, scene(VignetteScene), shots(Record<phraseId,ShotChoice>), coverage, report}. VignetteScene.pose(t) poses the whole scene (real teacher@1.0.0, classroom@1.2.0 doorway, door@1.1.0 hinged leaf, S5 action tracks, S3 FaceTrack). poseAt(shot, beat.start, t) gives the solved lens; beatAt(plan, t) gives the active beat. web-entry.ts (window.__vignette) is the reference for rendering VignetteScene in-browser: applyShake({pos,target,fovY,roll}, scene.vfx(f).shake, t, plan.seed), renderer.render(scene.root, cam, scene.lighting(f), fx.post, fx.particles), drawVignetteOverlay(g, beat, t, w, h). The new adapter must FUSE web-entry's vignette rendering with stills-page's S7 capture/overlay layers (FrameCapture initCapture/encodeRange/meta, evalVfxEvents/applyZoom/EmoteLayer, WorldTextLayer, drawOverlay caption placement clear of projected faces incl. the teacher's face). Beat-sheet fixture packages/director/fixtures/free-coins-classroom.beats.json already stages all 14 beats with teacher exit(p01)/return(p13)/present(p14), real door open/close, and full-body actions (walk, look_around, celebrate, dance, look_at, head_shake, press_button, facepalm, shock_recoil, stand_up, arms_crossed, flattened). Available camera recipes in CAMERA_RECIPES include establishing_wide, low_angle_hero, two_shot, insert_prop, wide_environment, medium_single, final_loop, slow_push_in, whip_pan, reaction_punch_in, over_shoulder, low_angle_reveal, chase_cam, etc. — used semantically per beat. verify-mvp.ts asserts the v1 full-render verification.json hashes are unchanged AND that sfx==19, music=='none', faceConflicts==0, narratedIntegration=='47/47'.
